svg.aria-label: Constructed ideal two-dimensional Gaussian-bleach images and central-intensity curves with a shared 0–1 color range and 5 μm scale bars. Defaults are diffusivity 1 μm²/s, radius 5 μm and mobile fraction 0.75. Curves compare region size and mobile fraction; images are model outputs, not microscopy measurements.
